race.comment: BLUE VALENTINE (7) is only lightly tried for a 4YO mare, and she has all the form on the board in this field. She drops 1.5kg from her last start second at Donald and is nicely poised to go one better in this. BOLSHOI BELLA (11) just battled on debut at Murray Bridge 11 days ago, and she will find this company more to her liking. Her trial from prior was good, and a form reversal is on the cards here. REBEL JEN (10) ran a bottler fresh up at Warrnambool just over a fortnight ago, and she maps to receive the run of the race from the pole position this time. The extra 200m will help her, and with a dip in class, she can improve sharply. COCOA CHARM (8) has had some gear changes leading into this fresh-up assignment, and despite the wide gate, she can figure in the top 4 at odds. NICALOHA (5) was a beaten favourite fresh up and then ran on well late last time out to finish third on this track 17 days ago. Keep him safe in all combinations.
